zh.title: 马里｜俄方非洲军团扩大巡飞弹打击，空袭伤亡上升
zh.summary: 路透社11月19日报道，CIG研究发现俄方Africa Corps在马里增加Lancet巡飞弹打击；援引ACLED数据，4月以来空袭频次及相关死亡人数显著增加。
zh.body: 事实：路透社11月19日引述Conflict Insights Group分析，识别出4月以来至少10次Lancet巡飞弹配合侦察无人机的打击。CIG引用ACLED数据称每周空袭由不足7次升至近16次，相关死亡由不足25人升至超过60人。研究人员认为至少一次打击几乎确定针对载有平民的车辆。分析：4月分离主义及基地组织关联武装联合进攻后，马里军方和俄方力量通过远程打击恢复主动。增加空中火力可能短期压制武装组织，同时使误判民用车辆和激化地方不满成为运营风险；另一解释是战场范围扩大导致打击增加。运营：在中北部矿业勘探、能源工程、运输活动中，按路线核对交战区域与空袭风险，重新授权野外车辆与承包商出行，审查车辆识别和停留点。跟踪：空袭坐标及平民伤亡、ACLED周趋势、军方调查、承运商改线及保险变化。来源：https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/russias-africa-corps-deploys-new-drone-mali-strikes-increase-analysis-says-2026-11-19/

en.title: Mali: Africa Corps expands Lancet strikes amid rising airstrike fatalities
en.summary: Reuters reported CIG findings on 19 November that Russian Africa Corps forces increased Lancet drone use in Mali, while ACLED-derived strike and fatality counts rose sharply after April.
en.body: Facts: Reuters reported a Conflict Insights Group assessment identifying at least ten strikes since April using ZALA Lancet loitering munitions with surveillance drones. CIG cited ACLED figures showing weekly recorded airstrikes rising from fewer than seven to almost sixteen and associated fatalities from fewer than 25 to over 60. CIG assessed that at least one strike almost certainly targeted a vehicle carrying civilians. Assessment: After the coordinated April insurgent offensive, Russian and Malian forces increased remote strikes to regain initiative. Greater strike capacity may bring tactical benefits but increases the importance of civilian vehicle identification and intelligence quality. An alternative explanation is that the larger battlefield and more targets explain the increased strike count. Business implications: Mining, energy and logistics operators in contested central and northern Mali should review route-specific exposure to aerial operations, field-vehicle authorisations, contractor movement, vehicle identification and stopping points. Indicators: strike locations and civilian harm, weekly ACLED trends, official investigations, carrier rerouting and insurance terms. Source: https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/russias-africa-corps-deploys-new-drone-mali-strikes-increase-analysis-says-2026-11-19/
